lines.start: Ms. Coral packs a beach ball, bigger and bigger! She's feeling everything at once!
lines.puffing: Ms. Coral's beach ball gets even bigger!
lines.fizzle: Plop! The giant beach ball deflates, and not one flies.

lines.intro: Ms. Coral, the lifeguard, spins round with swirly eyes. "NOBODY splashes on MY beach!"
lines.command: How can Fae calm Ms. Coral?

soothe.great: Fae blows a gentle whistle tune. Ms. Coral's swirly eyes start to slow down!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. Ms. Coral stops blowing her whistle for a moment.
soothe.miss: Ms. Coral blows her whistle right over Fae's humming.

play.great: Maddie rolls a beach ball back. Ms. Coral follows it, giggling!
play.good: Maddie nudges a beach ball. Ms. Coral chuckles.
play.miss: Maddie slips in the sand. Ms. Coral snorts.

cast.great: Sue swings her ribbon bobber like a lasso. Ms. Coral cheers as it loops the loop!
cast.good: Sue's bobber twirls over the sand. Ms. Coral leans in to watch.
cast.miss: Sue's line tangles on the dock. Ms. Coral shakes her head.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three beach balls in a perfect loop. "Bravo!" Ms. Coral claps.
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a beach ball high. Ms. Coral's eyes follow it up and down.
juggle.miss: Jordan's beach ball plops in the sand. Ms. Coral doesn't even look.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. Ms. Coral munches it between whistles.
lines.burst: Ms. Coral winds up and sends a storm of beach balls at Fae!

burstResult.great: Fae catches every beach ball, like a pro!
burstResult.good: Fae catches most of the beach balls!
burstResult.miss: Plop! Beach balls bounce all around Fae.

lines.soothed: Ms. Coral blinks. The swirls fade from her eyes, and the whistle slips from her hand.
lines.rest: Fae is worn out from all the splashing. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away. Ms. Coral packs another beach ball.
